labels.title: Accounting export - sales journal
labels.intro: Completed orders of the period, once each (the same orders Statistics counts as revenue). Cancelled and unfinished orders are not included.
labels.lines: One row per priced line (base wash + add-ons) instead of per order
labels.fiscalPending: Cash/card sales still waiting for a till receipt number
labels.empty: No completed orders in this period.
labels.mapping: The columns are fixed and documented (docs/FISCAL.md). This is a universal journal, not the import format of a specific accounting program: map the columns in the program's import. The Jumis and Horizon import specifications could not be verified - ask the vendor for their import description.
